buttons.btnCopy:
Copies the name of the selected layer, if no layer is selected,
the value of the first available one is copied
buttons.btnSave:
Saves the value from the name template input field to the presets.
Shift + Click - Updates the values of the selected preset
buttons.btnCircleMinus: Delete the currently selected template in the preset list.
buttons.btnRename:
Click - Apply template.
Shift + Click - Add template value to the beginning of layer name.
Ctrl + Click - Add value to the end of layer name.
Alt+Click - Invert all variables mode "I"
buttons.btnVariables: Open the variable values panel for the layer.
buttons.btnHelp: Open the library of all variables and their modes.
buttons.btnReset:
Reset all values.
(Does not delete presets and variable settings)

radioButtons.rdoAllLayers: All available layers in this composition will be used.
radioButtons.rdoOnlySelected: Only the layers you select will be affected.

dropdowns.ddLayerMode: Select a name template from saved presets.
